thread:
Jordan Lee: FYI customer OrionAI reported two invoices for May with different totals; second one missing the reserved-compute line. ticket#80456
Hannah Ortiz: can you drop the invoice ids?
Jordan Lee: inv_20260531_orionA and inv_20260531_orionB
Marc Dubois: quick note: inv A = $3,540.00 (includes reserved compute $3,000.00), inv B = $540.00 (reserved line missing). customer angry.
Jordan Lee: customer claim: B arrived later as "final" and they were charged the lower amount but their dashboard shows balance tied to A -> double-charge fear.
Alyssa Tran: pulling logs now. looks like de-dup key matched but a downstream metadata sync failed and retry code created a second invoice and left the original in "processing" state.
Marc Dubois: logs: ```WARN 2026-05-31T23:59:58Z billing: start invoicing acct=orion id=acct_554
INFO 2026-05-31T23:59:59Z metadata-sync: fetching plan=reserved-compute -> ok
ERROR 2026-06-01T00:00:01Z metadata-sync: write-metadata timeout -> raising transient
INFO 2026-06-01T00:00:02Z billing: retry mode triggered (retry_count=1)
INFO 2026-06-01T00:00:03Z billing: invoice-complete invoice_id=inv_20260531_orionB lines=[usage-only]
WARN 2026-06-01T00:00:04Z billing: original invoice inv_20260531_orionA left in processing and later voided -> charge token issued```
Hannah Ortiz: so the retry dropped reserved lines because metadata write hadn't completed; dedupe didn't detect because we only check invoice_key not content.
Jordan Lee: customer should not be left uncertain. immediate plan?
Alyssa Tran: propose steps: 1) pause any automated balance reconciliation for acct_554; 2) issue replacement invoice regenerated from canonical metadata (branch fix/metadata-sync-gate); 3) create credit for the phantom voided charge; 4) add an audit note and customer-facing explanation + apology.
Marc Dubois: finance approves credit for the phantom charge and replacement invoice. request legal review if wording mentions internal error.
Hannah Ortiz: I'll run a dry-run regen on the fix branch and paste preview (redact charge ids).
Alyssa Tran: dry-run preview: ```invoice_preview: account=acct_554 period=2026-05-01..2026-05-31 lines=[reserved-compute: $3000.00, burst-usage: $540.00], total=$3540.00``` looks right.
Jordan Lee: great. Hannah, please send replacement invoice to customer with credit note for the voided phantom charge and ask them to ignore inv_B. include clear line-level proration details.
Hannah Ortiz: will do and attach audit entry. also opening PR to gate invoice finalization until metadata-sync ack (PR #905).
OpsBot: Automated alert: monitoring enabled for acct_554 for 72h for duplicate-key invoice events and zero-line invoices.
Marc Dubois: add postmortem item to improve dedupe to compare line signatures and to avoid exposing charge tokens from voided invoices.
Jordan Lee: thanks team. tracking in ticket#80456, will follow up after the rebuild and customer email.
